name: HCP Publishers / CPD-CME Portals / Learning Publishers

pain_points: Low engagement with static CPD/education content
Shallow engagement and weak outcomes evidence
Insight arrives too late to iterate
Sponsor reporting pressure with limited proof

fit_logic.proceed: Sponsor pressure + owned distribution + desire to iterate fast
fit_logic.park: Wants outcomes but has no operational owner for iteration
fit_logic.stop: Pure content studio with no channel and no proof requirement

what_they_do: Sell audience access and outcomes to sponsors/funders/subscribers
what_proof_means: Sponsor-ready outcomes evidence and renewal defence
yoke_weaknesses: If there is no distribution channel at all

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps HCP publishers turn static content into interactive learning that drives higher engagement, reveals content gaps, and provides sponsor-ready proof for renewals.

pain_to_platform_to_outcome.pain: Low engagement with static CPD/education content
pain_to_platform_to_outcome.platform: Interactive journeys + gap analysis + engagement heatmaps
pain_to_platform_to_outcome.outcome: Higher completions, more subscribers, better outcomes

key_benefits: Convert static content into interactive journeys that increase completions
Reveal content gaps and audience needs through decision data and search signals
Provide sponsors with confidence shifts, decision pathways, and benchmarking
Increase retention with personalised learning and progress tracking
Generate trendlines across series for sponsor renewal packs
use_cases: CPD/CME programmes with sponsor reporting requirements
Multi-series educational portals with longitudinal insight
messaging.elevator_pitch: HCP publishers face sponsor pressure for outcomes proof while engagement stays shallow. Yoke converts your static content into interactive learning that reveals what works, what gaps exist, and provides sponsor-ready evidence—increasing completions and defending renewals.
messaging.outreach_angle: Quick question on sponsor outcomes reporting and content engagement for CPD/CME programmes

unknowns: Typical budget bands by publisher size
Procurement patterns for platform vs content

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase sponsor renewals with outcomes proof and higher engagement
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce content production cycles and reporting burden
